Lina (AE): CedarBridge procurement froze the PO. They want: SOC2 cover page, ISO scope excerpt, a signed pen-test attestation, and confirmation we can host a dedicated staging tenant for a 48-72h external scan. They need this to clear legal/compliance.
Tom (PreSales): We can provision an isolated staging tenant. Need their scanner IP ranges + expected peak RPS. If they run heavy traffic, pricing will change.
Isha (Security): We have a pen-test attestation template. Legal must approve the signer (they asked for a senior exec). We can provide a remediation summary (dates, severity, summary) but not raw internal tickets.
Lina (AE): They also asked about KMS separation and whether we can rotate keys during the test if they bring an authenticated scanner.
Mark (CloudOps): For authenticated scans we can create a short-lived service principal (48h TTL) and rotate keys post-test. KMS control: full customer key control requires Private deployment; for staging we can provide customer-scoped keys with audit logs.
Tom (PreSales): Note for pricing — if we carve out a dedicated pool for their scan window and ops standby, add a one-time + recurring surcharge. I'll draft numbers after they share expected qps.
Isha (Security): Also require tester insurance cert and a brief test plan listing allowed vectors. We'll refuse low-level kernel/firmware fuzzing unless pre-approved and scheduled in maintenance.
Lina (AE): Procurement wants artifacts by EOD Fri. I'll ask CedarBridge for tester name, insurance, CIDRs, and test plan.
Tom (PreSales): Example presign workflow for test data (advise synthetic data):
```bash
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-temp/cedar-test-data.tar.gz --expires-in 1800
# restrict bucket policy to their CIDRs and GET only
```
Isha (Security): I'll prep SOC2 cover page + ISO scope excerpt + draft attestation (redacted controls mapping + remediation summary). Legal review needed for signer field.
ticket-bot: Created ticket SEC-6730: "CedarBridge POC evidence & external scan coordination" assigned to Isha (Security). Priority: high.
Lina (AE): Action list: Isha -> upload artifacts & attestation; Tom -> estimate cost delta for a 72h isolated scan; Mark -> confirm runbook for tenant provisioning and key rotation; I'll chase CedarBridge for CIDRs & insurance. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Tom (PreSales): I'll post a provisional +12% delta for the dedicated carve + 24/7 ops standby; will refine when they share load.
Isha (Security): One more thing: we'll offer a read-only log snapshot during the window, but we won't expose full request bodies. We'll provide filtered exports for their triage.
Lina (AE): Great. I'll update procurement and push the buyer.
